peerPortfolioCoverage.securityFinding: The proposal preserves per-PoC approval isolation and material macro/OLE/DDE/link, formula-injection, HTML active-content/SSRF, OCR-content, PDF/A-oracle and Markdown-sanitization controls. Every candidate, numeric ceiling, corpus/oracle, license/security review and execution authority remains unresolved; none may inherit POC-PDF-001 authority.

The proposal denies public AI/translation, silent upload, endpoint/device/model execution and iOS reopening, and preserves offline proof, consent, untrusted-output and zero-cost boundaries. Exact device/provider/model/runtime/assets, data policy, numeric ceilings, corpus/oracles, licenses and PRE-012 remain unresolved. POC-CONV-004 overlaps the conversion/OCR packet consistently: deterministic-first and any OCR/AI fallback separately governed.

Open report: predictor overflow/unbounded decompression; exact 12.4.1 applicability remains unresolved.

processModuleDllSearch: Capture guest process tree from launcher through termination with image path, command line, parent, start/end time, hash and signer.
Capture every loaded module with resolved absolute path and SHA-256; compare against a separately approved exact module set.
Record SafeDllSearchMode, KnownDLL resolution, current/working directory, PATH, DOTNET_ROOT, runtimeconfig, deps and native probing paths.
Plant uniquely named unsigned canary DLLs in writable/current/input directories and prove they are never opened or loaded.
Stop before corpus parsing on an unapproved child process, module, search path, writable executable directory or hash drift.
networkEgress: Prove effective guest network disabled and firewall deny-default after boot; configuration text alone is insufficient.
Capture DNS, TCP, UDP and WinHTTP/WinINet activity for all allowed processes from pre-launch through teardown.
Use a local blocked-resolution canary and prove zero successful or attempted external egress; never contact the public canary.
Hash/export firewall, route, adapter, proxy and DNS snapshots without secrets.
Stop on any destination, DNS query, listening socket, proxy use or evidence gap.
tempResourceCancelCleanupCanary: Use a fresh run ID and guest-only temp/work directory; deny host temp, profile, registry persistence and undisclosed mappings.
Before parse, freeze numeric wall-clock, CPU, working-set/private-byte, handle, child-process and output-growth ceilings plus sampling cadence.
Exercise cooperative cancel, timeout kill-tree, crash and forced-teardown paths; record exit code, latency and complete process-tree death.
Hash before/after input, output, evidence and mapped-path inventories; prove source immutability, bounded output and zero residue outside the run root.
Use non-PDF sentinel/canary files around all writable and forbidden paths; prove no read/write/delete outside the exact run root.
Quarantine partial outputs and distinguish CANCELLED, TIMEOUT, RESOURCE_LIMIT, CRASH and SECURITY_STOP from functional failure.
After each run, destroy the disposable guest and independently verify host mapping cleanup and no surviving process, handle or lock.

failClosedStopRules: Stop if any source, candidate, config, command, process, module or evidence-schema hash differs from its approved manifest.
Stop if PRE-003 through PRE-011 are not evidenced and PRE-012 is not explicitly approved by its human authority.
Stop if the run is launched from this review; this review provides no execution authority.
Stop on any undeclared child process, shell, interpreter, package acquisition or executable from a writable path.
Stop on any module outside the approved absolute path/hash set or any DLL canary access/load.
Stop if DLL search-order evidence is incomplete or includes current/writable directories ahead of trusted locations.
Stop on any DNS query, socket, listener, proxy, external route or network-evidence blind spot.
Stop if input mapping is writable or if output/evidence/temp mappings are absent, ambiguous or overlap input.
Stop before hostile input if numeric time, CPU, memory, handle, process and output ceilings are not frozen.
Stop and kill the full process tree on timeout, resource threshold, cancellation deadline, crash or telemetry loss.
Stop if cancellation cannot bound termination latency or if any process/handle survives cleanup.
Stop if a canary/sentinel outside the run root is read, written, renamed or deleted.
Stop if source hashes change, partial output escapes quarantine or residue exists outside the run root.
Stop use of qpdf linearization-check arguments while OFF-QPDF-1739 applicability remains unresolved.
Stop hostile PDFsharp parsing while SEC-G-001 lacks an accepted mitigation/fix disposition.
Stop if evidence contains secrets, production documents, unnecessary document content or unapproved identifiers.
Stop on official advisory/provenance drift until the exact candidate decision is refreshed.
Stop after the first security invariant failure; do not continue remaining experiments for coverage.
invalidation: Any bound-source drift, candidate/hash/version change, task-card/authority change, new advisory, host/sandbox profile change, or future observation invalidates this disposition and requires independent re-review.
stopMarker: BLOCKED_SECURITY; route to governance only as a blocker packet, never as execution approval.
